reviews.title: Es una estafa 👎🏽
reviews.text: Publicidad engañosa. Cumplí con todos los requisitos para canjear mis puntos a PayPal. Dicen que el pago tarda 14 días hábiles, pero ya pasó casi un mes y la transacción sigue estancada en "Revisión de riesgos" sin ninguna explicación. No pierdan su tiempo jugando ni viendo anuncios aquí porque no transfieren el dinero.

reviews.title: Had Promise! Honest Review
reviews.text: Your app worked for my first redemption....then after that every other time my redemption went under the category of "Risk Reviewing"....never got it resolved after contacting support because they never answered. Tried one more time to see if it was glitch, went to the same thing. Deleted my account. Dont know what happened but I at least got $5 to my paypal. Thanks for the $5 guys. Wish I could have earned more with you.

reviews.title: It’s a scam
reviews.text: This app showed great promise. I quickly got to $5 and cashed out successfully. It’s super easy. I got to my next $5 and I went into risk review. This was beginning of May. I tried email support. No one answers back. I got to another $5 because maybe it’s a glitch. This one is also in risk review. $10 waiting. Don’t waste your time. There’s better apps that actually pay. I’ll change my review if I get paid. But as of now, I’m no longer using the app. Only holding onto it to check my money status in hopes that I’ll get it. Fairly sure I won’t be tho. 2 months have gone by on my second withdrawal.
